in_marathi.name: Kamya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kamya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kamya is derived from the Sanskrit language, meaning 'desire' or 'longing'. In Hindu mythology, Kamya is a name given to various goddesses, including Kamya Devi, the goddess of desire and passion.
